title: Association profile conditioning in a set-temporal transformer for cross-session intracortical motor decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.39080v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intracortical motor decoders degrade across sessions because the set of recorded units changes and persisting units can alter how their firing relates to behavior. Most existing methods update network weights on each new session or rely on unlabeled activity, which does not directly reveal such changes. We present APST, an Association Profile-conditioned Set-Temporal transformer that adapts to new sessions with all network weights frozen. From a few labeled calibration trials, APST summarizes how each unit's firing relates to behavior in a four-dimensional association profile computed in closed form. The profiles condition a set-attention encoder that accepts any number and order of units, followed by a causal transformer for streaming decoding. On held-out DANDI688 sessions from two monkeys, APST reaches velocity $R^2$ of $0.78$ and $0.81$, versus $0.40$ and $0.58$ for a variant that uses neural activity alone, and matches or exceeds

translated_title: 基于关联概况条件化的集合-时间Transformer用于跨会话皮层内运动解码
translated_abstract: 皮层内运动解码器在跨会话时性能会退化，这是因为记录的神经元集合会发生变化，且持续记录的神经元可能会改变其放电与行为之间的关联方式。现有的大多数方法在每个新会话上更新网络权重，或依赖无标签的神经活动，而这些方法并不能直接揭示此类变化。我们提出了APST（关联概况条件化的集合-时间Transformer），它在所有网络权重冻结的情况下即可适应新会话。APST从少量有标签的校准试验中，以闭式解计算出四维关联概况，以此总结每个神经元的放电与行为之间的关系。这些概况条件化一个集合注意力编码器，该编码器可接受任意数量和顺序的神经元，随后连接一个用于流式解码的因果Transformer。在来自两只猴子的DANDI688留出会话上，APST的速度R²分别达到0.78和0.81，而仅使用神经活动的变体仅为0.40和0.58，并且匹配或超过……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出APST方法，通过闭式计算的四维关联概况对集合-时间Transformer进行条件化，在所有网络权重冻结的情况下即可适应新的神经记录会话，显著提升了跨会话皮层内运动解码的性能。
en_tdlr: APST conditions a set-temporal transformer on closed-form four-dimensional association profiles, adapting to new neural recording sessions with all network weights frozen and substantially improving cross-session intracortical motor decoding performance.
